caption: The drawing depicts a vintage-style sofa with an ornate wooden frame and dark upholstery. The sofa has three backrest sections, each with a rounded, oval shape and bordered by the curving wooden frame. The central backrest is the largest, flanked on each side by slightly smaller, matching sections. The wooden frame features carved detailing at the top center above the middle backrest, as well as along the arms, which curve outward. The seat of the sofa is wide and upholstered in a dark gray or black fabric, matching the fabric on the backrests. The legs of the sofa are also wooden, curved, and taper downward, with each foot resting lightly on the floor. The entire composition is set against a plain, light background, with the sofa centered in the frame. The artist's signature, "Geoffrey Holit," appears in the lower right corner of the image.
title: Settee, Walnut
